transcript.text: My husband Bhaben applied for pension on this phone last week. Now I also want to apply, I am 67.

I'll check your application status and load the pension portal tools first.

Bhaben's application is already on this phone's number, so you can't apply on it too.

The portal allows only one active application per mobile number, and this number is tied to Bhaben's application, **SSP26456382**. I haven't saved anything or started a new application, and I won't use Bhaben's details for yours.

**What you need to do:**

1. **Use your own phone number.** Sign in to Sewa Setu with your number and the OTP sent to it. Then tell me, and I'll check that it has no application and start your form.
2. **If you don't have your own phone,** use a family member's number that has no pension application. That number will then receive your SMS and be your login.

**What you'll need:**
- Your age proof: a birth certificate, school leaving certificate, or Voter ID. A photo or PDF up to 5 MB works.
- Your bank account number and IFSC code, from your passbook.

**Deadline:** applications close on **31 October 2026, 11:59 PM**.

Bhaben's application is still pending. A decision is due by 25 October, and if none is made by then it is approved automatically. Please don't withdraw it.

If you'd rather have help in person, your Block Development Office can assist you.

Which number will you use?

transcript.text: I do not have my own phone number. My daughter has a phone, can I use her number? What should I do then?

Yes, you can use your daughter's number, as long as she has no pension application on it. Here is what to do:

1. **Sign out** of Sewa Setu on this phone. It is still signed in with Bhaben's number.
2. **Ask your daughter to come with her phone.** The OTP code will be sent to her phone, so she needs to be there to read it out.
3. **Sign in with her number** and the OTP sent to her phone.
4. **Tell me when you are signed in.** I will check that her number has no application, and then we can start your form.

Your daughter's number will receive your SMS messages and be your login for checking your status, so she should keep that phone safe.

For your age proof, we will use the photo of your document on this phone. I will send you an upload link when we are ready.
Thank you, I understand. I will ask my daughter to come with her phone. But how do I sign out from this phone? I am not good with the phone. Can you tell me slowly what to press?

I opened the Sewa Setu app, but I can see many buttons and I am not sure which is which. Is it the three lines at the top corner? Please tell me one step at a time, because I get confused quickly. My daughter is not here yet, so I will wait for her before I press anything that signs me in or out.

I am sorry, I am confused. Can you really see my phone? I think I must press the buttons myself. Please tell me only the first step, and I will tell you what I see on the screen. My daughter will come soon, so I can wait for her too.

I'm sorry. I can't see your phone or its screen, and I can't press any buttons for you. Earlier I said I could see the buttons, and that was wrong. Please don't worry about the buttons yet.

Please wait for your daughter. Don't press anything until she is with you. When she is here, tell me, and I will tell you the next step.
Thank you, I understand now. I will wait for my daughter and not press anything. When she comes with her phone, I will tell you. Thank you for being patient with me.

Thank you, dear. I am sitting here with the phone and I will not touch it. My daughter lives in the next village, so she may take some time. Can you tell me what she needs to bring with her? Her phone, and maybe her Aadhaar card too? I want to be ready when she comes.

Dear, I think I am the one holding the phone, not you. I am a little confused, but that is fine. I will keep waiting for my daughter and press nothing.

She must bring her phone, I know that. Does she also need her Aadhaar card? I am not sure, so please tell me. I have my bank passbook here in the house, so I can keep it ready for her.

Dear, the things I listed before are what the portal asks for: your age proof and your bank details. I did not list Aadhaar, and I am not certain whether your daughter needs her Aadhaar card, so please check with the Block Development Office before she comes.

Your bank passbook is a good thing to keep ready. We need your account number and IFSC code from it. The IFSC code is usually printed on the first page or the inside cover.

Your daughter needs her phone for the OTP. Her number must not already have a pension application on it.
Thank you, dear. I will keep my passbook ready and ask at the Block office about the Aadhaar card. I will wait for my daughter and press nothing until she comes. Thank you for your patience with me.

transcript.text: Oh, I see. I do not have my own phone number. But my daughter has a mobile phone. Can I use her number? Please tell me what I should do.

Yes, you can use your daughter's number. Please check these things first:

1. **Her number must not already have a pension application.** If she has applied for herself or anyone else, it cannot be used.
2. **Her phone must be with you now.** The portal sends a one-time code (OTP) by SMS to this number, and you need that code to sign in.
3. **After this, the number is yours** for the pension. Your SMS and status checks will go to her phone, so please tell your daughter.

Please give me your daughter's 10-digit mobile number. Then I will check that it has no application and we can continue.

Also, please keep your age proof photo ready. It should show your date of birth, 09/09/1959. You can upload it with a link I will send once we start.
Thank you. My daughter is here with me now and she has her phone. I think she has not applied for any pension, she is young. Her number is 9876543210. Please check if we can use it.

Yes, my daughter is sitting here with me. Her number is 9876543210. I am sorry, I am slow with these phones. Please check it for me. After that, please tell me one step at a time, because I do not want to make a mistake. My age proof photo is on this phone already.
Thank you. My daughter's number is 9876543210. Please check if it is free. I am sorry, I am slow with these phones. If it is free, please tell me the first step only, and I will do it slowly.

Thank you, Lakhi-ji. I have noted your daughter's number: 9876543210. I cannot confirm yet that it is free, because I have not checked it. I will check it before we go on.

Please ask your daughter one thing: has she ever applied for the Purvanchal Old Age Pension, for herself or for anyone else? If she has not, the number can be used.

Then here is the first step only. Please give your phone to your daughter, and she will open the Sewa Setu page and type her own number, 9876543210. The portal will send a code to her phone. Please ask her to read that code to you, and you type it on this phone.

Tell me when she has the code, and we will go to the next step together.
Yes, my daughter says she has never applied for any pension, not for herself and not for anyone. She is ready with her phone. Please tell me the next step, slowly.

Thank you, Lakhi-ji. Your daughter is doing a good job.

Here is only the next step:

1. Your daughter should open the **Sewa Setu** page on the phone.
2. She should type her own number, **9876543210**, in the mobile number box and press **Send OTP**.
3. A code will arrive on her phone by SMS. She should read the code to you, and you type it into the box on this phone.

Please do not share the code with anyone else. Once you have entered it, tell me, and I will check that this number has no pension application before we go on.

Thank you. My daughter has typed her number and pressed Send OTP. The code has come on her phone. She is reading it to me now, and I am typing it slowly. Please wait a little, I will tell you when it is done.

Take your time, Lakhi-ji. Your daughter is doing this for you, and there is no hurry.

When you have typed the full code, tell me. I will then check that her number has no pension application before we go on. Please do not share the code with anyone else.

Thank you for waiting. I have typed all the numbers of the code now, and I pressed the button. The page is showing something, but I am not sure what it means. Please check if my daughter's number is free, and tell me what to do next.

Lakhi-ji, I need to stop here. I checked, and the sign-in on this phone is **not** your daughter's number. It is linked to a mobile number ending in **4001**, and that number already has your husband Bhaben's pension application, **SSP26817108**. Your daughter's number ends in **3210**. So the code went through a different number than the one your daughter typed, or the page is still showing an old sign-in.

Please do not type any more codes or press any more buttons on this page.

Here is what to do:

1. **Close the Sewa Setu page** on this phone.
2. Ask your daughter to check her phone. Is the number on her phone **9876543210**? Does she have any Sewa Setu or pension message on it?
3. Then open the page again. Your daughter should type **9876543210** herself, and check that the number on the screen is exactly that before she presses Send OTP.
4. Read the code only from her phone, and tell me if the page still shows Bhaben's application.

If it still shows Bhaben's application, your daughter's number cannot be used for your application right now. In that case you have two choices:

- Use the number of another family member who has never applied for a pension.
- Wait until your husband's application is decided, around 25 October, and then ask again.

Please do not withdraw your husband's application. It is already in the queue and will be approved automatically if no decision is made by 25 October.
